title: Reports of a paused DeepSeek funding round
reason: Rumor / unnamed-sources claim type (verification.md §3) -- Bloomberg's own reporting states it 'hasn't verified the authenticity' of the viral posts/transcript attributed to Liang Wenfeng that reportedly triggered the pause, and DeepSeek's telling backers of a pause is itself sourced to unnamed people familiar with the matter. Wire-exclusive check: every outlet found (China Money Network, Yahoo Finance, Investing.com/Reuters relay, US News, Business Standard, cryptobriefing.com, Fortune, WDC TV) traces to the same Bloomberg story, not independent reporting. No DeepSeek statement. Never publishable as fact per policy; held internally as watching.
watch: A DeepSeek statement confirming or denying the funding pause
Independent reporting (not relaying Bloomberg) on either the pause or the authenticity of the viral posts/transcript
Resumption or formal termination of the funding round, which would itself be the more solid news event
